xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe: 3.The above FR’s have been reviewed by the AC and approved by the BoD at their respective meetings held on Nov 03, 2026. 4. The above FR’s have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in IAS 34 "Interim Financial Reporting" ("Ind AS 34"), prescribed under Sec 133 of the CA, 2013 and other accounting principles generally accepted in Ind and in compliance with Reg 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Reg, 2015. 5. RML ('the Company') and its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as 'the Group') are primarily engaged in the manufacture and supply of auto compo’s for the transportation industry which in the context of IAS (Ind AS) 108 Operating Segments, is considered as the only operating segment of the Group. There are no unallocated corporate income / expense / asset and liabilities considering that the Group operates in a single segment. 6. Exceptional items in the above FR’s include the foll: - The Co had recorded gain on sale of land INR 341.13 crs and stamp duty exp of INR 1.48 crs in relation to acquisition of the Friction Business of HCL for qtr and half y/e Sep 30, 2026. - The Co incurred VRE amounting to INR 1.59 crs for q/e Sept 30, 2025, INR 2.60 crs for half y/e Sept 30, 2025 and INR 3.47 crs for the y/e Mar 31, 2026. 7. Pursuant to the agreement to sell with Canopy Living LLP (a JV b/w Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd and Prestige Estates Projects Ltd) and upon transfer of possession and fulfilment of the conditions specified in the agreement, the Co has recorded the sale of 3.48 acres of land parcel situated at Velachery, Chennai during the qtr and six months ended Sep 30, 2026 for an aggregate consideration of INR 361.18 crs. Accordingly, gain arising on sale of such land amounting to INR 341.13 crs has been presented as an "Exceptional Item" in the FR’s. The Co has received sale consideration of INR 200 crs in respect of the aforesaid agreement, and the balance consideration will be received in accordance with the terms of the agreement. 8. On Aug 20, 2026, the Co completed the acquisition of the Friction Business of HCL as a going concern through a slump sale arrangement pursuant to a BTA for a consideration of INR 365.72 crs. These FR include the financial performance of the Friction Business from the acquisition date. The Co is in the process of completing the PPA in accordance with Ind AS 103 "Business Combinations". Accordingly, as on the acquisition date, it has provisionally recognized the fair values of the identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed. The excess of purchase consdn over the provisional FV of the net identifiable assets acquired has been allocated to goodwill. 9. The Std and Consol FR’s for the qtr and h/e Sep 30, 2026 are being published in the newspaper as per the format prescribed under Reg 33 of SEBI (LODR) Reg, 2015. The Std and Consol FR’s are also avl on the SE websites of BSE (www.bseindia.com) and NSE (www.nseindia.com) and on the Co’s website viz., www.ranegroup.com.
